metaTitle: How to Store Drinking Water at a Campsite
description: Store camp drinking water safely with food-grade containers, cool shade storage, date labels and bleach or filter treatment, plus how much per person to bring.
directAnswer: Use clean food-grade containers with tight lids, keep them cool, shaded and dated, and bring at least 1 to 2 gallons per person per day. Treat uncertain water by boiling, filtering or bleach per the label, standing 30 minutes.
